description: Source code implementing TCP packet creation and manipulation for IPv6, including functions to generate TCP RST packets within the quic namespace.

classes.name: TCPv6Packet
classes.description: Structure representing an IPv6 TCP packet with IP and TCP headers.

classes.name: TCPv6PseudoHeader
classes.description: Structure representing the pseudo-header used for TCP checksum calculation in IPv6.

methods.name: CreateTcpResetPacket
methods.description: Creates a TCP RST packet based on an original IPv6 TCP packet, flipping source/destination addresses and ports, and computing checksum.
